text:
In the world teetering on the brink of destruction, the chosen one, Kai, was destined to harness the ancient magic to restore balance. Instead of merging his spirit with the magic and losing his human existence, Kai discovered that the ancient magic required a vessel, not a sacrifice. He channeled the energy through his own body, using his willpower to contain the storm rather than becoming it. The magic stabilized, the world was saved, and Kai survived, forever changed but still human, retaining his memories and his life.

The capital of France is Paris.
